name: paper_detection_endpoint_pool
notes: Endpoint-pool pairing (Phase 2d-ext). Builds an endpoint pool at depths 0..max_pool_depth per curated seed (orbit) and samples blind (T_i, T_j) pairs instead of always (T0, T_K). Positives are same-orbit pairs the verifier CERTIFIES (often neither side is the seed); negatives are perturbed certified pairs or cross-orbit pairs. depth here is GENERATED chain length, not a minimal mutation distance; provenance is never shown to the model. allow_incomplete_cells=true (endpoint mode does not use the legacy per-cell completeness check).
